KAZAR / ACCESSIBILITY

Accessibility

A website designed for clear access to project information.

01

Using the website

Navigate with a keyboard, use visible focus, expand the KAZAR Standard, and view drawing captions alongside their source records. Reduced-motion preferences are supported in the design.

02

Technical drawings

Drawings include text descriptions, status and credit. The viewer provides zoom controls and a contained scroll region.

03

Accessibility statement

Target: WCAG 2.2 AA. This is a design and development target, not a conformance claim. Publish the tested scope, known limitations, review date and approved support channel after implementation testing.

04

Request assistance

Use the contact form to describe the information or format you need.
